newsitem.title: LEBANON: New daily paper Beirut Times to appear on Friday.
newsitem.headline: New daily paper Beirut Times to appear on Friday.

text.p: The Beirut Times, a new English-language Lebanese newspaper, will appear on newsstands on Friday, its publisher said on Thursday.
"The Beirut Times will primarily address the business community, offering its members an indispensable product in their daily life," Antoine Kehdy told a news conference.

The paper, with offices in Washington, London and Paris and correspondents in the Gulf, Syria, Jordan, Palestinian self-rule Authority areas and Egypt, hopes to cater for the growing needs of expanding Lebanese and regional markets.

"We believe that there is a need for a credible English-language business publication...This need will become greater as regional markets expand and develop and as the hope for peace brings prosperity to the region," Kehdy said.
He said paper would issue 7,000 to 10,000 copies daily with a target of 25,000 in the near future.
Last November the English-language Daily Star reopened in Beirut after an 11-year absence during the 1975-1990 civil war.
